intro: Interactive tools for tabletop gaming. Each tool runs in your browser and is powered by the Moddable engine.

featured.title: Look it up
featured.desc: Search across all published rulebooks. Find the exact rule mid-game, no page-flipping.

sections.heading: Game Night
sections.sub: Tools you reach for at the table.

tools.title: Time's up
tools.desc: Per-player countdown timer with cumulative stats.

tools.title: Who goes next
tools.desc: Turn order tracker with initiative rolls.

tools.title: Who are you, really?
tools.desc: Assign hidden roles for social deduction games. Tap-to-reveal, no app needed.

tools.title: Take your seats
tools.desc: Random player seating around the table.

tools.title: Name your character
tools.desc: Works for any hex-tile explorer, faction leader, or rule-bending rogue.

tools.title: Keep the count
tools.desc: Tracks up to 6 players. Good for Catan VP, TI4 objectives, anything with points.

tools.title: Track the economy
tools.desc: Multi-resource bank per player with trade logging. Built for Econopoly, Nukes, TI4.

tools.title: What's left?
tools.desc: Track drawn tiles/cards. See remaining odds. Presets for Catan, Carcassonne, Scrabble.

per_game_sub: Dedicated tools built for specific games.

per_game.title: Twilight Imperium
per_game.sub: Galaxy generator, Faction picker, Objective tracker, Agenda voter

per_game.title: Talisman Worlds
per_game.sub: Hex board generator, Character lottery, Encounter draw

per_game.title: Nukes
per_game.sub: Hex map generator, Combat calculator, Hostage tracker, Unit reference

per_game.title: Dice Lab
per_game.sub: Dice roller, Battle simulator, Risk, TI4, Axis & Allies, X-Wing, Blood Bowl, Memoir '44

per_game.title: Card Deck Builder
per_game.sub: Design, Shuffle, Deal — custom decks for any game

per_game.title: Oracles & RPG Library
per_game.sub: Scene Forge, RPG Browser, Encounter Builder — 10 systems, 3000+ entities
